title: 07. Advanced & Agentic RAG: MCP Techniques Summary
summary: MCP TECHNIQUES SUMMARY: explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    MCP TECHNIQUES MAP                             │
├────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  TECHNIQUE         │  DESCRIPTION                                │
├────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Tool Calling      │  LLM invokes tools via JSON-RPC             │
│  Resources         │  Read-only data exposure (files, APIs)      │
│  Prompts           │  Reusable prompt templates                  │
│  Sampling          │  Server-side LLM requests                   │
│  Streaming         │  Real-time token streaming                  │
│  Multi-Server      │  Connect to N servers simultaneously        │
│  Context Injection │  Pass metadata/logs via Context object      │
│  Error Handling    │  isError flag + ToolError exceptions        │
│  Auth              │  OAuth 2.0, API key, mTLS                   │
└────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
